conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: Sorry ma'am. I'm afraid I can't let you disturb our guests in the front.

conversations.name: Me
conversations.content: (She’s smiling politely, her manners flawless, but for some reason it feels deeply unsettling.)

conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: Is there anything else I can't help you with, ma'am? If not, please step aside.

conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: The economy class restroom is at the other end.

conversations.name: Me
conversations.content: (Her eyes just now were terrifying. I’d better move on.)
